raw.excerpt: On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare.
raw.description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We’re inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations.

About the Role

Qventus is seeking an Implementation Engineer to lead the delivery of our Inpatient and Surgical Growth solutions at scale. Our platform helps health systems optimize patient flow, reduce length of stay, improve discharge planning, and drive surgical growth and OR utilization through AI-powered workflows and predictive analytics. In this role, you will serve as the technical expert for our suite of products — communicating requirements to external clients and internal teams, managing hospital-specific data transformations, building custom EHR integrations, executing product configuration and data validation, and supporting clinical workflow rollouts. You will work closely with hospital stakeholders and R&D counterparts to deliver scalable, high-quality data pipelines that drive measurable improvements across inpatient operations and surgical growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Communicate technical product requirements and provide support to external clients and internal development teams, ensuring optimal utilization of Qventus modules; gather and analyze user requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and develop configuration plans with appropriate timelines.
  • Serve as the expert for the Qventus product suite, with deep knowledge of the data structures, relational databases, integrations, reporting, and metric development that underpin each module, including AI/ML-powered inpatient and surgical growth workflows and real-time analytics.
  • Lead technical implementations of Qventus solutions end-to-end, including Inpatient Operations and Surgical Growth: validate clinical data sources, configure relevant capacity and workflow metrics (e.g., bed capacity, discharge planning, OR scheduling and case volume), and manage the full lifecycle from requirements through unit testing and customer sign-off.
  • Perform SQL-level checks on data integrity and system performance; develop, execute, refine, and optimize advanced SQL queries against databases (Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) to validate data quality and system behavior.
  • Query relational databases and configure technical systems including Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems; develop monitoring mechanisms and automated alerts to proactively identify and prevent production data quality issues.
  • Collaborate with Integration teams to identify and resolve data interoperability issues; perform root cause analysis on data pipeline failures, evaluate HL7/FHIR integration configurations, and implement corrections both historically and going forward.
  • Manage and execute data migrations from legacy hospital systems, minimizing disruption to patient care while maintaining data integrity throughout the transition.
  • Direct production support for customer issues post-deployment: actively monitor support channels, own issues from identification through resolution, and coordinate across internal teams to restore normal system function.
  • Develop deployment-related technical content and training materials, including starter content for product modules; deliver advanced technical training to new employees and customer teams, presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Identify process gaps within product administration and configuration; perform analysis to design optimal workarounds or reconfigurations, and make detailed technical recommendations to resolve platform deficiencies.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions for hospital system integrations; identify improvements to Qventus solutions in collaboration with R&D partners and contribute to scalable, long-term platform evolution.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated experience building, debugging, and enhancing production healthcare data transformation pipelines; highly proficient in SQL and at least one modern data warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, BigQuery).
  • 3+ years of professional experience with modern programming languages such as Java, C/C++, or Python, with a dedication to high code quality.
  • Experience translating hospital requirements into technical designs for hospital operations (inpatient and/or surgical) and executing across multiple technologies and platforms in fast-paced environments (AWS preferred).
  • Understanding of healthcare data structures related to hospital operations, such as bed management, patient flow, OR scheduling, or surgical case volume; familiarity with relational database technologies including Redshift and RDS.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate technical issues clearly to clinical leadership, hospital IT teams, and non-technical stakeholders alike.

It’s a Plus if You Have…

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with HL7, FHIR, or other healthcare data standards; familiarity with integration middleware such as Mirth or Rhapsody.
  • EHR system integration experience (Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and aptitude for interpreting complex clinical datasets, including length of stay, discharge barriers, bed utilization, OR block scheduling, or surgical case data.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt, Terraform, Looker, and/or Ansible; background building hospital performance metrics and real-time clinical monitoring systems.

Compensation for this role is based on market data and takes into account a variety of factors, including location, skills, qualifications, and prior relevant experience. Salary is just one part of the total rewards package at Qventus. We also offer a range of benefits and perks, including Open Paid Time Off, paid parental leave, professional development, wellness and technology stipends, a generous employee referral bonus, and employee stock option awards.

Salary Range
$120,000—$140,000 USD

Qventus values diversity in its workforce and proudly upholds the principles of Equal Opportunity Employment . We welcome all qualified applicants and ensure fair consideration for employment without discrimination based on any legally protected characteristics, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, "protected characteristics"). Our commitment to equal opportunity employment applies to all persons involved in our operations and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee, including supervisors and co-workers.

Qventus participates in the E-Verify program as required by law and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in compliance with Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). In compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Qventus provides transparency into how applicant data is processed during the application process. Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our candidate privacy notice.

*Benefits and perks are subject to plan documents and may change at the company's discretion.

*Employment is contingent upon the satisfactory completion of our pre-employment background investigation and drug test.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.

What You Will Do:

  • You’ll be the face of Insider One to our clients! You’ll be the bridge between their needs and our technology.
  • Help our clients understand their needs and which of our features and products best match their goals and expectations.
  • Make sure our clients are utilizing our technology at its best so that we can fully provide them our world-class service.

  • Proactively provide constant feedback to your team on market trends, unmet needs, and opportunities to create a bigger impact on our partnership with our client.
  • Establish a trusted advisor relationship that ensures our customer's overall satisfaction with our services and technology.
  • Plan strategies to help the customers meet their objectives, prioritizing and driving resolution on escalated customer issues. Bring new product ideas to the table!

What You Will Need:

  • Previous work experience in customer-facing roles, such as customer success, account management, or strategic consulting. Show us that you’ve got what it takes to collaborate and build strong relationships with customers, especially at the executive level.
  • Solid oral and written communication abilities, with positive and energetic phone skills and excellent listening skills.
  • We’ve got clients all over the world! Be a self-motivated and savvy tech bug, always in search of savvy solutions and ideas to improve our relationship with our clients.
  • Cherish one of our core ethos: care. You’ll need to care for our clients and make sure they feel at home with our products and our assistance. Superior project and time management skills. A keen eye for detail is a plus!
  • Passion for testing, measuring, and improving outreach and follow-up effectiveness.
  • The ability and flexibility to work in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Strong communication skills in English and German.

What We Offer:

  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.

  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.
We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.
To do this, we are looking for the exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

Client Success & Campaign Manager
Location: Remote — Philippines

Number of Openings: 1 Position
Industry: Gaming, Esports, Influencer Marketing & Digital Entertainment
Compensation:$5.00 – $9.00 USD/hour
English Proficiency: Advanced (C1/C2) – Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
Schedule: Full-Time | Schedule aligned with client and campaign needs

About the Company
This opportunity is with a fast-growing talent management and influencer marketing company operating within the gaming, streaming, esports, and digital entertainment industries.
The organization partners with international brands and digital creators to execute high-impact influencer campaigns across multiple platforms. Its culture is collaborative, fast-paced, creative, and results-oriented, offering team members the opportunity to work at the forefront of influencer marketing, gaming, and digital media.
About the Role
We're looking for an experienced, highly organized, and client-focused Client Success & Campaign Manager to lead the execution of influencer marketing campaigns for global brand partners.
This is first and foremost a high-volume Project Management and Client Success role—not a sales position. Once the Sales team closes a new client, you'll assume full ownership of the campaign, managing every phase from onboarding and planning through execution, reporting, and successful completion.
This position requires exceptional project management skills, polished client-facing communication, and the ability to successfully manage a large portfolio of concurrent campaigns involving multiple creators, stakeholders, and internal teams across different time zones.
The ideal candidate has proven experience managing complex marketing campaigns, enjoys working in fast-paced environments, and thrives when balancing multiple priorities while delivering outstanding client experience.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Join a rapidly growing company operating at the intersection of gaming, esports, influencer marketing, and digital entertainment.
  • Own high-profile influencer campaigns from kickoff through completion.
  • Work directly with international brands, creators, and cross-functional teams.
  • Gain exposure to global campaigns spanning multiple markets and time zones.
  • Develop expertise in client success, campaign strategy, and large-scale project management.
  • Build a long-term career in one of the fastest-growing segments of digital marketing.
What You'll Do
Client Success & Relationship Management
  • Take ownership of client relationships immediately after new campaigns are closed by the Sales team.
  • Serve as the primary post-sale contact throughout the entire campaign lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive communication, strategic guidance, and exceptional service.
  • Present campaign timelines, progress updates, and performance results professionally and confidently.
  • Manage client expectations while ensuring a consistently positive experience.
  • Address client questions, concerns, and feedback promptly and professionally.
Campaign Planning & Strategy
  • Develop campaign plans aligned with client objectives and marketing goals.
  • Define deliverables, creator requirements, timelines, KPIs, and execution strategies.
  • Translate client expectations into actionable campaign plans.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and maximize ROI.
Campaign Execution
  • Own the end-to-end execution of influencer marketing campaigns from post-sale kickoff through final reporting.
  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 25–45 concurrent campaigns while coordinating multiple creators and campaign activations simultaneously.
  • Coordinate campaign execution across multiple international time zones.
  • Ensure campaign deliverables are completed accurately, on time, and within budget.
  • Maintain consistent communication across clients, creators, sales, talent managers, and internal teams throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Project Management
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, task lists, approvals, and delivery schedules.
  • Coordinate multiple stakeholders while balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Anticipate project risks and proactively resolve issues before they impact campaign success.
  • Maintain exceptional organization while managing a high-volume workload.
  • Ensure campaigns remain on schedule despite changing priorities and multiple moving pieces.
Creative Coordination
  • Collaborate with creators and internal creative teams to develop compelling campaign assets.
  • Review campaign content to ensure quality, accuracy, and brand alignment.
  • Coordinate revisions, approvals, and final asset delivery.
  • Ensure creative deliverables meet both client expectations and campaign objectives.
Budget Management
  • Manage campaign budgets of up to approximately $200,000 USD.
  • Track campaign spending and monitor budget utilization.
  • Identify financial risks and ensure campaigns remain within approved budgets.
  • Maintain accurate financial tracking throughout campaign execution.
Campaign Analysis & Reporting
  • Monitor campaign performance across engagement, reach, conversions, ROI, and other key performance metrics.
  • Analyze campaign data to identify trends and opportunities for optimization.
  • Prepare professional client presentations, campaign reports, and executive summaries.
  • Present campaign insights and recommendations clearly to clients and internal leadership.
  • Provide regular updates regarding campaign progress, risks, budgets, and performance.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • 3–5 years of experience in Project Management, Client Success, Campaign Management, Account Management, or a related client-facing role.
  • Proven hands-on experience managing marketing campaigns from planning through execution and reporting.
  • Strong Project Management skills with experience managing multiple concurrent projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume campaign portfolios.
  • Excellent client-facing communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders across different departments.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1/C2).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance data.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Comfortable coordinating projects across multiple international time zones.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Direct experience of managing influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Experience working in social media marketing, creator partnerships, talent management, gaming, esports, or digital entertainment.
  • Experience managing large portfolios of simultaneous marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with influencer marketing KPIs, sponsorship activations, and creator deliverables.
  • Experience working with international clients and distributed teams.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:
  • Successfully manage 25–45 concurrent campaigns while maintaining exceptional quality and organization.
  • Deliver campaigns on time, within budget, and according to client expectations.
  • Transitioning new clients seamlessly from Sales into campaign execution.
  • Build long-term client relationships through proactive communication and exceptional service.
  • Coordinate creators, clients, and internal teams across multiple global time zones.
  • Identify and resolve campaign challenges before they impact client satisfaction.
  • Deliver clear reporting and actionable campaign insights that support future success.
Why Join Us?
  • Work at the intersection of gaming, esports, influencer marketing, and digital entertainment.
  • Manage campaigns involving internationally recognized creators and global brands.
  • Gain experience managing significant campaign budgets and high-volume activations.
  • Collaborate with experienced professionals across sales, talent management, creative, and analytics.
  • Join a creative, fast-growing, and collaborative organization.
  • Fully remote work environment with long-term career growth opportunities.
Important Notes
Applications may receive priority consideration if candidates:
  • Have proven Project Management and Client Success experience.
  • Have successfully managed 25–45 concurrent marketing campaigns or similar high-volume project portfolios.
  • Have direct experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, gaming, esports, or digital entertainment.

  • Have experience coordinating projects across multiple international time zones.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Can independently own campaigns from post-sale kickoff through final reporting.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

The ideal candidate will have an established history of success in the space/aerospace community with the desire to join a fast-paced, multitasking, innovative team. In this role, knowledge of the industry, customer engagement, and a desire to create something new will be the hallmarks of success.

SEAKR empowers its employees. As a key member of the R&C team, you will be able to pursue ideas you’re passionate about and drive them to completion. You will be collaborating with company stakeholders as the team lead on campaigns and be responsible for the identification of new business opportunities. Deep knowledge of the space industry, customers, competitors, missions, systems, and supporting technologies will be critical. Job Title: Manager, Pricing & Negotiation – Diabetes Care Division (Ontario)

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position is field-based in Ontario. The ideal candidate will be based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). At Abbott, we believe people with diabetes should have the freedom to enjoy active lives. That’s why we’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health more effectively and comfortably, with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.

As a member of our Market Access team, you will be accountable for identifying and executing pricing and negotiation strategies for the portfolio of products and play an active role in pCPA and private payer negotiations to execute listing agreements and drive identification of pricing opportunities in various markets.

You provide expertise, leadership and guidance through process improvement, interactive communication and cross-functional collaboration. You build a variety of strategies, support scenario analysis as part of the market access and brand planning process, and provide insights and guidance on emerging trends, challenges and opportunities in the pricing, contracting and related market access areas aligned to our strategic direction.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide subject matter expertise to the market access team as well as the local and North America organization on Canadian and provincial pricing regulations and requirements for all diabetes care products
  • Applies brand knowledge and pricing expertise to build and implement pricing strategies to maximize commercial contribution for assigned portfolio across the lifecycle including launch, negotiations, loss of exclusivity and divestiture
  • Work with market access and stakeholder relations managers to develop financial models supporting proposed pricing strategies & identify opportunities for innovative pricing constructs
  • Actively participate in pCPA, provincial and private payer negotiations for diabetes care products to optimize the commercialization of existing or emerging products
  • Lead negotiation of product listing agreements and product listings, while balancing speed and value
  • Support team to ensure contracts are compliant and aligned with corporate and legal requirements
  • Track performance against contractual terms and KPIs
  • Collaborate with market access team on the design, negotiation, and implementation of innovative contracting solutions
  • Support lifecycle management of agreements, ensuring performance tracking and optimization
  • Identify opportunities for novel reimbursement models and strategic collaborations
  • Responsible for securing local and NA approval for product portfolio price strategies (list, net) and ensuring public and private payer contract terms and conditions support organizational objectives
  • Communicate complex issues and challenges clearly and appropriately to internal and external partners

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, or life sciences
  • 5 or more years related pharmaceutical industry experience
  • Understanding of pricing opportunities and considerations in various markets such as public, private, hospital, public health, etc.
  • Proven experience leading payer negotiations
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and translate insights into actionable strategies
  • Strong analytical skills – forecasting, financial modelling, business impact analysis and database management
  • Experience with Canadian payer environment, pCPA, provinces and private
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and time management, prioritization skills and attention to detail.
  • You enjoy working and collaborating with all levels of the organization and can influence across the enterprise
  • Demonstrated ability to operate strategically and influence at a senior level
  • Excellent oral, written, and analytical skills with demonstrated experience required in scenario planning, decision-making and solution development

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $134,000.00 to $170,000.00 CAD. The salary range provided applies to Canada only and does not apply to any other locations outside of Canada.

raw.title: Sales Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: About Rhapsody: Healthcare is innovating fast and AI is accelerating the pace.
raw.description:
About Rhapsody:

Healthcare is innovating fast and AI is accelerating the pace. But AI is only as good as the data it can securely access. Today, moving data between providers, payers, and digital health innovators is still harder than it should be, and inconsistent data quality creates risk, rework, and stalled initiatives.

Our mission is to accelerate innovation by reducing the burden of data access and data quality so teams can build, deploy, and scale solutions with confidence. Rhapsody provides behind-the-scenes interoperability and data quality foundation that helps information move reliably between systems, across formats, and at the speed modern healthcare demands.

Most people won’t ever see our products during a medical visit (that’s infrastructure). Think of Rhapsody as the connective tissue and increasingly, the “data readiness” layer that enables digital transformation, analytics, and AI initiatives by making data accessible, trustworthy, and actionable.

If you want to help solve one of healthcare’s hardest problems, turning fragmented data into safe, usable information—apply at rhapsody.health.

About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on, people-oriented Sales Operations Manager to work side-by-side with our sales leaders and reps. This is not a systems or analytics-heavy role — we have those covered. What we need is someone who thrives on making sales teams more effective: cleaning up the pipeline, building and improving processes, creating training and documentation, and being a trusted operational partner to sales leadership day-to-day.

At Rhapsody, we are an AI-first company, meaning we actively use and embrace artificial intelligence to enhance how we work, collaborate, and deliver. We expect our team members to be open to adopting AI tools in their roles, continuously exploring ways to work smarter, improve efficiency, and drive innovation while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and ethical responsibility.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership Partnership

  • Act as a dedicated operational partner to sales managers and leaders — joining pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and team meetings to understand where the team is struggling and help solve it
  • Help sales leaders identify patterns in their pipeline and team behavior that indicate process gaps or coaching opportunities
  • Support onboarding of new sales hires by facilitating process walkthroughs and ensuring they ramp quickly on how we sell
  • Serve as a sounding board and thought partner for sales leaders as they make decisions about territory, coverage, and team structure

Pipeline Hygiene & Inspection

  • Own and enforce pipeline hygiene standards — ensuring opportunities are accurately staged, properly documented, and consistently maintained in the CRM
  • Run regular pipeline reviews and audits; proactively flag stale deals, data gaps, and forecast risks to sales leadership
  • Work directly with reps to coach CRM discipline and reinforce best practices around deal documentation and stage progression
  • Partner with our data analyst on light reporting needs — pulling pipeline snapshots, deal aging reports, and coverage analysis to support weekly and monthly reviews

Process Documentation & Improvement

  • Document existing sales processes end-to-end, from prospecting through close, creating a clear and accessible playbook for the team
  • Identify process gaps and inconsistencies; lead cross-functional working sessions to align on improvements and get buy-in from stakeholders
  • Translate complex processes into simple, practical guides and training materials that reps actually use
  • Own the ongoing maintenance of process documentation — keeping it current as the business evolves

Training & Enablement

  • Design and deliver process-focused training sessions for new and existing sales reps — covering selling methodology, CRM usage, and deal management expectations
  • Build a culture of operational excellence by reinforcing process standards in a way that is collaborative, not policing
  • Coordinate with sales managers to identify knowledge gaps and build targeted enablement to close them
  • Develop quick-reference tools (cheat sheets, job aids, templates) that help reps execute the right behaviors in the flow of their day

AI:

  • Transforms workflows to be AI-first by connecting tools, building scalable automations, and standardizing best practices across teams to drive efficiency and consistency.
  • Leads AI adoption by coaching others, identifying high-impact use cases, and balancing experimentation with governance and quality standards.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, or a similar role working directly with sales teams
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with salespeople and sales leaders — you know how to earn credibility on the floor
  • Strong process documentation skills — able to take a messy, undocumented process and turn it into something clear, practical, and scalable
  • Experience managing pipeline hygiene and running pipeline review processes in a CRM environment (Salesforce preferred)
  • Comfortable facilitating training sessions and coaching reps on process and tool adoption
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail; able to manage multiple projects without dropping the ball
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain complex processes simply and get people on board

Preferred

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS or technology company
  • Background in sales enablement, sales training, or sales coaching
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger, Command of the Message)
  • Exposure to working alongside a dedicated RevOps, CRM admin, or data/analytics function

Rhapsody provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

The expected pay range for this position is $120,000 – $150,000 USD annually, representing the anticipated base salary range for a full-time, exempt hire. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and work location.

This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on company and individual performance, as well as participation in Rhapsody’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes health coverage, retirement savings, paid time off and other programs that support your overall well-being.

What we have to offer you:

  • Comprehensive benefits package on day 1 (medical, dental, vision, life, disability)
  • 401k with a generous company match
  • Unlimited PTO, sick time & volunteer days
  • An innovative, inclusive, and fun work environment
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities

  • A demonstrated track record of building go-to-market methodology, not just delivering training, across multiple GTM segments such as sales, customer success, services, or partners

Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

WW also includes Med+, a telehealth service that connects members with certified clinicians for services such as GLP-1 medications (when appropriate) and menopause hormone therapy, along with access to Registered Dietitians through Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) visits available via insurance-covered sessions or self-pay options.

  • Currently board-certified by an ABMS board to include Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Preventive Medicine, OB/GYN.

    • Windows 11

  • Review and discuss patient intake information and medical history through video and chat consultations to provide appropriate clinical guidance and treatment.

raw.description:
Who Are We?

Xcelirate develops technologically-advanced platforms which are accessed by thousands of users every minute! We are proud to offer a workplace where the sharpest developers come together to strategically plan and swiftly execute practices which see us maintain our existing market dominance and attain global expansion. We owe our success to our customers who have seen us grow across a decade, and our talented team who have made that growth possible!

What are we looking for?

You’re a Full-Stack Dev - you’ve been around the block, and you know your way through both backend trenches and frontend battlefields. PHP? Still your reliable sidekick. JavaScript? Sometimes a mischievous friend, sometimes a chaos gremlin, but you’ve learned how to keep it in line.

You work best with fierce independence. You don’t need hand-holding - you’re the one who does the hand-holding when it’s needed. You don’t wait for direction; you are the direction. To twist a phrase: you’re not the one who knocks, you’re the one who delivers.

You live for making things work. Whether that’s a clean new feature, a quirky legacy bug fix, or tracking down why that button refuses to do what it’s told. You like code that’s neat and maintainable, but you’re also practical - you know sometimes duct tape is exactly what the situation calls for.

Building apps is your thing - you tinker, refactor, and optimize because you can’t help yourself. You get a kick out of speeding things up, cleaning things up, and occasionally wondering what exactly your predecessor was drinking when they wrote that function.

And yes, you’re not afraid to dive into the relics. That PHP app last touched in 2010? It still needs love. The JavaScript file with 1,200 lines and no semicolons? You’ll wrestle it into submission.

What will you be doing?

  • Manage your own time while adhering to priorities set by the company.
  • Build new features and improve existing ones across our platforms.
  • Refactor and enhance applications to keep them performant, scalable, and maintainable.
  • Write tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to ensure software reliability.
  • Be involved in every phase of the software lifecycle, from ideation to deployment.
  • Participate in deep technical discussions and help shape our applications and infrastructure.
  • Get hands-on with all elements of the stack, from backend logic to frontend interactions.
  • Identify inefficiencies and help streamline workflows, reducing unnecessary work.
  • Take ownership of your work, ensuring high-quality results and maintainable solutions.

Requirements

What will you bring along?

  • 10+ years of PHP development, with expertise in at least one framework (Symfony, Zend preferred).
  • 12+ years of web application development experience: you’ve seen the evolution of web tech and know how to build for the future.
  • 6+ years working with frontend frameworks/libraries like Vue.js, React, Nuxt, or Next.js.
  • Deep understanding of scalable web architectures: monolithic, microservices, or hybrid, you know when to use what.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both engineers and non-engineers.
  • Passion for automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end) and test-driven development (TDD).
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in PHP development, debugging, and algorithm/software design.
  • Knowledge of agile development tools, techniques, and principles.
  • Familiarity with Ansible and Terraform for infrastructure automation.
  • Experience deploying, managing, and scaling applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Strong grasp of web security: encryption, authentication, authorization, and everything in between.

We're always looking for the best candidates, so if you think you would be a good fit even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we would love to hear from you!

Benefits

How We Support Our Contractors

  • An annualised rate of €125,000 + retention bonus scheme: Competitive contractor rate with a generous bonus paid every 6 months based on your time with us.
  • Top-Notch Workstation: We provide the latest MacBook, branded merchandise, and everything you need for an optimal work environment.
  • Global Co-Working Access: Work from a global network of co-working spaces to keep your work-life dynamic and flexible.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy full flexibility in work location and hours, supporting a work-life balance tailored to your needs.
  • Events and Gatherings: Participate in exciting events throughout the year, including team gatherings, cultural events, and other fun activities.

raw.description:
Are you ready to own the intersection of AI, product strategy, and engineering execution? Can you translate bold business ambitions into scalable, secure, high-performing technology and AI products, leading hands-on delivery while embedding AI-native practices that unlock speed, quality, and sustained innovation?


Come Join ReSource Pro!

Your Role...
As a Senior Principal, Product Engineering, you will bridge business strategy and engineering execution owning delivery outcomes for scalable, secure, and high-performing technology & AI products across 2-4 strategic initiatives. This role drives measurable improvements in velocity and cycle time by shaping product and engineering delivery through AI-native practices. Partnering closely with software engineering, architecture, data, and DevOps teams, the Senior Principal defines product requirements, prioritizes technical initiatives, and leads end-to-end delivery—ensuring technology investments are tightly aligned to business outcomes while enabling sustained innovation, operational efficiency, and measurable customer value.

This is a hybrid technical product leadership role that blends product ownership with hands-on execution to accelerate delivery, remove friction, and ensure initiatives ship with speed, quality, and impact across assigned product areas.

We hire the best because we believe great people create exceptional experiences. That's why we hire individuals who not only bring talent and passion, but who thrive in our unique culture and live out our Core Values: Commitment to Community, Teamwork, Passion for Excellence, Service-Centric, and Best Self.

All remote positions are based in the United States, and candidates must reside within the U.S. to be eligible for consideration.

In This Role, You Will...

  • Translate strategic objectives into well-defined epics, user stories, and technical acceptance criteria that enable autonomous, high-velocity engineering execution; Translate strategy into detailed epics, user stories, and technical acceptance criteria that guide engineering execution.
  • Partner with architects to ensure system designs meet performance, security, and compliance standards across environments.
  • Lead backlog prioritization to maintain velocity and technical quality.
  • Act as a hands-on, embedded technical product leader, stepping in where needed across discovery, design, delivery, and troubleshooting to unblock teams, accelerate progress, and ensure alignment across disciplines.
  • Directly contribute to execution when needed (e.g., prototypes/spikes, debugging, performance tuning, instrumentation/observability, automation/CI/CD improvements) to unblock delivery and accelerate outcomes.
  • Leverage data instrumentation, analytics, and observability tools to assess product health, performance, and ROI.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices, CI/CD optimization, and automation efforts to improve release reliability and deployment speed.
  • Establish cycle time, flow efficiency, and throughput as primary KPIs; accountable for demonstrable improvement across assigned product areas.
  • Model and institutionalize AI-native product and engineering practices, including AI-assisted discovery, design, coding, testing, and operations.
  • Influence prioritization, sequencing, and technical investment decisions to optimize flow, balancing feature delivery, platform health, and technical debt reduction to sustain long-term velocity gains.
  • Partner with software engineering, architecture, and infrastructure leaders to shape technical direction and operating models that remove friction, reduce cycle time, and enable predictable, high-throughput delivery.
  • Lead technical discovery and product design sessions, serving as subject matter expert (SME), converting complex business and operational needs into well-structured platform capabilities; Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for assigned products, fully owning knowledge of functionality, architecture, dependencies, and integration points.
  • Own outcomes across 2-4 product areas by driving cross-team dependency alignment, surfacing tradeoffs, and ensuring initiatives ship to measurable impact.
  • Promote hands-on collaboration between Product, Engineering, and Service Delivery, fostering a culture of transparency, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Introduce and train teams on modern product management methodologies, emphasizing discovery-driven development and customer-centric design.

What You Need to be Successful…

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Product Development, Business, or related field
  • 15+ years of progressive experience with products, engineering, development, and project management
  • Experience working with C-Suite; Brand or product development management experience
  • Previous experience leading a team and/or cross-functional initiatives(direct or matrix leadership)
  • Experience using AI Coding for Production Application ( Vibe Coding) >1 year
  • Must be able to operate across the full lifecycle: discovery → requirements → delivery → production operations, including hands-on troubleshooting and technical contribution when needed
  • Proven track record leading complex, highly technical product initiatives, involving APOs, microservices, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Demonstrates relentless curiosity—proactively dives into systems, data, and workflows to deeply understand how products operate, where friction exists, and what opportunities will most improve outcomes.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and complexity, forming well-reasoned points of view and confidently providing recommendations grounded in technical insight, data, and business impact.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills demonstrating an ability to "tell a story
  • Knowledge / familiarity with BPO or insurance industry (preferred)
  • Strong entrepreneurial spirit; high energy level, sense of urgency, responsive, confident, thorough, not afraid to make decisions
Your Benefits & Perks...
  • Generous PTO plan with paid holidays + floating holidays
  • 100% paid Employee Healthcare on Day 1
  • Eligible for all medical, dental, and vision benefits on Day 1
  • 401k with employer match, vested on Day 1
  • Opportunity to work for a growing, global organization.
  • Ability to engage with clients and internal partners to make an impact.
  • Organization-wide focus on growth and development

Your Compensation…
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes annual bonus eligibility, benefits, and other opportunities at ReSource Pro. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity relative to other ReSource Pro employees. This is a remote position, and the salary range for most locations for this role is $145,899 - $247,039 annually. The salary range may vary based on experience and on the specific geographic location in which the candidate resides.

Your Interview Process...
To be considered for this position, please submit your application. If you meet the qualifications for the role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to schedule an interview via zoom.

The standard interview process includes:

  1. Behavioral interview with Talent Acquisition
  2. Online talent assessment
  3. Hiring Manager Interview with Chief Information Officer
  4. Stakeholder Interview with Senior Director, Software Engineering
  5. Stakeholder Interview Team Expert
  6. Business Case

*Additional interview steps may be added depending on the position or if further evaluation is needed.

Disclosure: Candidates are evaluated at each step of the process. As a result, not every candidate will complete all steps in the process.

About ReSource Pro:

Focused exclusively on the insurance industry, ReSource Pro is the trusted partner insurance organizations rely on to optimize performance, streamline operations and process engineering, and drive growth. Serving 2,000+ carriers, brokers, wholesalers, and MGAs, ReSource Pro is a recognized market leader in insurance workflow optimization, data and technology services, and strategic operating model transformation. Maintaining a 96%+ client retention rate for over a decade, ReSource Pro is the only firm serving the insurance industry to have earned a spot on the Inc. 5000 list 16 times—placing it among the top 0.02% of repeat honorees across all sectors in the Inc. list’s 40+ year history.

Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

ReSource Pro provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

raw.description:
Location: Our Solutions Engineer, DoiT Cloud Intelligence, will be an integral part of our Solutions Engineering / Field Engineering team in APAC. This role is based remotely in APJ timezone, and requires native-level Thai language fluency to serve our Thai customers, prospects, and AWS field teams.

Who We AreDoiT is a global technology company empowering cloud-driven organizations to achieve business growth and innovation through strategic cloud utilization. We blend data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state, from initial planning to full-scale production.
With extensive experience across various cloud environments, we possess deep specializations in Cloud Data Platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, as well as FinOps expertise. As a trusted and award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we proudly support over 4,000 customers worldwide.
Our flagship offering is DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI), which uniquely combines advanced technology with human insight, enabling us to solve complex multicloud challenges and drive significant efficiency for our clients.

The DoiT Cloud Intelligence platform:

  • Provides deep visibility into cloud cost, usage, performance, and optimization opportunities across complex multi-cloud environments, enabling organizations to make data-driven infrastructure decisions.
  • Combines automation, analytics, and expert guidance to identify savings opportunities, improve resource efficiency, and continuously optimize cloud investments at scale.
  • Powers Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Systems Integrators (SIs), and Private Equity (PE) operating teams with portfolio-level insights, benchmarking, and operational tooling to manage multiple cloud environments effectively.
  • Goes beyond reporting by delivering prescriptive recommendations and automated workflows that help engineering, finance, and platform teams turn cloud intelligence into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

The Opportunity

As a Solutions Engineer supporting DoiT Cloud Intelligence in Thailand, you will be the hands-on technical face of DoiT in the local market. Partnering with Account Executives, Customer Success, and the AWS field team, you will help Thai enterprises, digital natives, MSPs, and Systems Integrators unlock actionable insights across their AWS and multi-cloud environments — driving cost efficiency, operational visibility, and smarter cloud decision-making through DCI.
This is a growth-oriented Field Engineering role. You are chartered to drive DCI and product adoption through high-impact technical sales plays, measurable revenue growth, partner-led pipeline, new logo acquisition, and upsell/cross-sell motions. You will sit at the intersection of customers, cloud platforms, and our product — an embedded technical partner inside the account team rather than a reactive support resource.

Responsibilities

Technical Qualification & Discovery: Collaborate with the Account Executive to thoroughly understand the prospect’s cloud environment, FinOps maturity, cost management challenges, and operational goals through in-depth technical discovery sessions across engineering, finance, and platform teams.
Technical Validation & POV Leadership: Own and drive technical validation and Proof of Value (POV) exercises for DoiT Cloud Intelligence, including POV preparation, proactive management, and ensuring successful technical outcomes that demonstrate clear value and alignment with prospect requirements.
Platform Demonstrations: Develop and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of DCI in Thai and English, showcasing cloud cost visibility, optimization insights, and operational intelligence across complex multi-cloud environments.
Business Case & ROI Development: Leverage your understanding of cloud economics and FinOps to build business cases and ROI analyses that clearly articulate the financial and operational impact of adopting DCI, for both engineering and executive audiences.
AWS Partner-Led Growth: Work with AWS field teams and local partners on co-sell motions, partner-sourced pipeline, and accelerator programs — including GenAI, Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), and Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR) engagements. Support GTM initiatives that convert partner relationships into qualified opportunities.
Hands-On Cloud Engineering: Act as a trusted cloud engineer who designs and helps implement improvements in cost efficiency, resilience, security posture, and operational automation. Lead structured technical engagements such as optimization sessions, reliability and security reviews, architecture deep dives, migration assessments, and Well-Architected style assessments.
DCI Power User & Expertise: Become the go-to expert for DoiT Cloud Intelligence in the region: build analytics and cost allocation views, surface cost and risk opportunities, write Composer queries, create CloudFlow automations, and embed DCI into customer observability, governance, and CI/CD workflows.
Partner & Portfolio Motion Support (MSP, PE, SI): Support technical engagements with MSPs, PE firms, and SIs by demonstrating how DCI enables portfolio-level visibility, operational insight across multiple cloud environments, and scalable optimization strategies.
Technical Win Ownership: Take full ownership of the technical win for DCI engagements — guiding prospects through evaluation, addressing technical requirements, and building confidence in the platform’s ability to drive cloud efficiency and operational insight.
Reusable Assets & Enablement. Convert field work into reusable assets: playbooks, Terraform modules, automations, architecture diagrams, internal tooling, and documented patterns. Create external-facing technical content such as webinars, workshops, and customer enablement sessions in Thai.
Event & Conference Presentations. Represent DoiT and DCI at local and regional events, AWS events, webinars, and industry conferences, delivering engaging presentations and demonstrations.
Product Feedback & Customer Advocacy. Translate customer pain points, partner requirements, and feature gaps into structured, technically credible input for Product and Engineering, helping shape the evolution of the Cloud Intelligence platform. Represent the voice of the Thai and APAC technical customer in roadmap discussions.
Accurate, Timely Documentation. Ensure timely entry of data into internal business support systems and contribute to the tools and metrics that highlight business performance and effectiveness.

About You

You are an accomplished Solutions Engineer or hands-on cloud architect with customer-facing experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or cloud consulting environment. You are a native Thai speaker who can move fluidly between a Thai-language executive conversation and an English-language technical deep dive with a global product team.
You are excited about enabling companies to transform themselves using the public cloud, and you hold yourself accountable for the success of any initiative you are involved in. You want to be part of a high-performance, growth-focused organization and you enjoy winning against the competition. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, entrepreneurial, remote-first environment across multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Native-level Thai fluency (spoken and written) with professional working proficiency in English.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on AWS (experience with GCP or Azure is a strong plus), with the ability to reason across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and observability.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales Engineering, or Field/Forward Deployed Engineering — selling or delivering into enterprise and mid-market accounts.
  • Depth in at least one technical domain: cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, or ML/GenAI.
  • Practical FinOps and cloud cost management judgment: the ability to explain cost-versus-performance-versus-reliability tradeoffs to both engineers and finance/leadership stakeholders.
  • Practical observability experience: monitoring, logging, and alerting, and an understanding of tools in the ecosystem such as Datadog, New Relic, ServiceNow, and cloud-native equivalents.
  • An automation mindset with coding or scripting ability, plus hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD tooling.
  • Strong data analysis skills and comfort navigating large data sets and spreadsheets to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and reconciliation needs.
  • The ability to take complex pieces of technology and explain them in a simple, easy-to-understand way.
  • Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive-level prospects and customers.
  • Comfort working in a metric-driven environment, reporting on and improving business performance against monthly KPIs.
  • Experience working in an account-team model across multiple functions (AE, CSM, AM, TAM) and time zones.
  • Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Bonus Points

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking, Machine Learning) or FinOps Certified Practitioner.
  • Prior experience working with or alongside AWS partner programs (MAP, WAFR, GenAI accelerators) or within an AWS Partner / MSP / SI.
  • Background in FinOps, SRE, or platform engineering.
  • Experience with cloud cost management or cloud intelligence platforms such as DCI.
  • Datacenter and hypervisor experience (e.g. VMware) in the context of migration to cloud.
  • Experience with modern technical selling best practices, including trial, demo, POV, and RFP processes.
  • Contributions to open source, public speaking, community leadership, or internal enablement.
  • Track record of success in a fast-growing and scaling business.

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ’apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it’s our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

We specifically seek professionals with a track record of hunting, solutioning, proposing, and closing net new revenue primarily within the Manufacturing and Non-Named Verticals. At Lakeshore, we make products that end up in the hands of children every day — and the educators who guide them. As a Territory Representative on our Inside Sales team, you'll build real relationships with schools, childcare centers, and community organizations, connecting them with the tools and resources that help children learn and grow. If you're energized by meaningful conversations, motivated by hitting goals, and excited to represent products you can feel good about, this role is for you.

A day on the job looks like this:

  • Grow a portfolio of school and childcare accounts by building genuine relationships through outbound calls and virtual appointments — turning first conversations into long-term partnerships
  • Partner with educators, administrators, and community organizations to understand their needs and match them with Lakeshore solutions, including our Complete Classrooms® program and professional development offerings
  • Host virtual product presentations and events that give customers a hands-on look at what Lakeshore offers and how it fits their learning environments
  • Monitor local, state, and national trends and funding opportunities in early childhood and elementary education to identify new business prospects in your territory
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and professional services teammates to sharpen messaging and ensure customers get consistent, high-quality support
  • Consistently hit daily activity targets and sales quotas, tracking your pipeline and progress in Salesforce

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience
  • Demonstrated ability to build rapport and communicate clearly across a range of audiences — from classroom teachers to district administrators
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment, managing your own schedule to meet daily activity and sales goals
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel) and the ability to learn new tools quickly
  • This is a fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in the U.S

Preferred:

  • Prior experience in inside sales, outside sales, or a customer-facing role where hitting goals mattered
  • Background in early childhood or elementary education — either working in it or selling into it
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM

What sets you apart:

  • You take feedback seriously and actually use it — you see coaching as a competitive advantage, not a critique
  • You stay organized and on top of the details even when you're juggling a full pipeline of accounts
  • You bring genuine curiosity to each customer conversation, asking questions before pitching solutions
  • You hold yourself accountable on the days when no one is watching — remote work energizes rather than derails you

And here’s our end of the bargain!

  • Hourly: $31.25-$36.05
  • Uncapped commission structure
  • Paid leave for new parents to support work/life balance and family bonding
  • Excellent medical/dental and vision coverage—EPO, PPO and HSA
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution (because you will retire someday)
  • Flexible benefit options—choose what you like, ignore the rest

At Lakeshore, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community that is representative of the teachers, families and children we serve.

We know we couldn’t do the extraordinary things we’re doing without the people on our team. Thanks to the passion and enthusiasm of this spectacular group, Lakeshore is more than a great place to work—it’s a great experience to be part of. Day in and day out, we give everything we’ve got to create products that instill a sense of wonder and foster a true love of learning. To help maintain this high bar for success, we’re constantly on the lookout for people to join us. So if you’re a down-to-earth professional who shares our desire for making a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

People are selected to become members of the Lakeshore family based on skill, merit and mind-boggling talent—not based on race, color, creed, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, marital status, domestic partnership status, military status, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, alienage, AIDS or AIDS-related complex status, genetic information, predisposition or carrier status, status as a victim of domestic violence, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. raw.description:
About Us

Let’s go on an adventure together!

Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.

For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.

At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers — you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.

Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.

Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.

About the Role

The Global Connection Officer (GCO) is a sales catalyst, relationship developer, service zealot, organizational wizard, traveller, trainer, problem solver, and company culture enthusiast all rolled into one!

G Adventures is a company that prides itself on changing lives through travel. We have a company culture based around unique core values that we live and breathe every single day. G Adventures has 26 years of success behind us, proven through double digit sales growth year on year, and a global family with 7 regional sales teams, 5 sales offices and 25 local offices.

Your mission as a GCO if you choose it, is to connect with our travellers and agency partners; recommending and selling them the right trips based on their unique needs.

What you'll be doing

Mission

  • Reach monthly sales targets while driving exceptional customer service KPIs

  • Work with both speed and efficiency while consistently displaying compassion and care in every interaction

  • Handle any booking issues calmly and with empathy

  • Differentiate your service to provide a uniquely G experience for our travellers

How your Mission is Achieved

  • Connect with our prospective travellers both over the phone and via email

  • Ask the right questions to ascertain the needs of each unique traveller

  • Recommend and sell the right trip for the traveller based on their needs including any extra services that may enhance their experience.

  • Ensure the use of correct booking processes and procedures to minimize risk and reduce error rates

  • Act at all times with the purpose of providing a life changing experience

  • Be an integral part of G Adventures amazing company culture and live by the G Adventures Core values.

  • Make meaningful connections with both the global team (including over 100 GCOs) but also your travellers.

Desired Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum 1 year front-line sales experience, motivated by revenue targets and service KPIs

  • Fluent in French, both written and spoken

  • A love of sales and travel

  • Experience using a GDS system, preferably Amadeus

  • Superior selling skills & exceptional customer service skills are required

  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills

  • Problem solving/complaint resolution skills

  • Extensive geographical knowledge & travel experience

  • Flexible and energetic, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team environment

  • Ability to work varying shifts and weekends as required

  • Ability to navigate and use a variety of computer systems confidently with speed and efficiency

  • Understanding of, and identification with, G Adventures’ Core Values

  • Enjoy being a part of a global team

Location: Open to remote candidates in Ontario, or office based candidates in Toronto.

Additional Information

  • Base Salary Hiring Range: $39,000.00 - $41,000.00 CAD annually

  • Eligible for incentive plan based on sales targets

Final salary offered will fall within the posted salary range and will vary based on the candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications

Note:

  • This is a general recruitment posting to build our talent pool for future opportunities. There may not be an existing vacancy at this time. We will contact qualified candidates as positions become available.

What Do We Offer You?

  • Competitive Total Rewards Package, including exclusive travel perks!

  • Additional days off, including on your birthday!

  • Vacation time for you to recharge

  • Enhanced Parental Leave

  • Meaningful Employee Recognition Program

  • Learning and Growth Opportunities

  • Employee Resource Groups

*Applicable based on location*

Please note that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is used in the selection or interview process.

G Adventures is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We consider all qualified applicants.

Job Description:

Job Title: Analyst,Sales Commissions

Location: Mexico - Remote

Reports to: Director, Comp & SPM Administration

The Opportunity

JD Power is seeking a Sales Commissions Analyst to support the administration, execution, and analysis of our sales commission programs. This role will help ensure incentive plans are processed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with business and go-to-marketobjectives.

This role sits within the Revenue Operations organization and reports directly to the Director, Compensation & Sales Performance Management (SPM) Administrator.

As JD Power continues to evolve and scale its commercial operations, this role offers the opportunity to help strengthen and modernize the company’s sales compensation processes, reporting, and systems. The Analyst will play a key role in improving operational efficiency, enhancing data visibility, and supporting scalable incentive compensation practices across a growing organization.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales,Finance, PayrollandHRand Revenue Operations. This role will also support commission reporting, system maintenance, and ongoing process improvements within our incentive compensation environment.

WhatYou’llDo

Incentive Compensation Administration

  • Support the administration and execution of sales commission plans.

  • Maintaincalculation oflogic, territory alignments, hierarchies, andcreditingrules.

  • Assistwith commission processing, validation, and payout reviews.

  • Support annual plan rollouts, mid-year changes, and compensation plan updates.

  • Helpmonitordata quality and ensure accuracy across source systems including CRM, HRIS, payroll, and finance.

  • Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and system enhancement initiatives.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Assistinthepreparation ofrecurring commission reports including payouts, attainment, and earnings summaries.

  • Support ad hoc reporting requests from Sales, Finance, and leadership teams.

  • Analyze commission data toidentifydiscrepancies, trends, and operational risks.

  • Assistwith commission expense reporting, accrual support, and forecasting activities.

  • Maintain dashboards and reporting tools to improve visibility into sales performance and incentive results.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Sales Operations, Finance, Payroll, and HR to supporttimelyandaccuratecommission processing.

  • Respond to employee commission inquiries and help resolve disputes in a professional andtimelymanner.

  • Support documentation of commission processes, policies, and procedures.

  • Assistwith audits and internal control activities related to incentive compensation.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, revenue operations, finance, or related analytical roles.

  • Experience working with incentive compensation systems such as Varicent, Xactly,CaptivateIQ, Callidus, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and data analysis.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with high attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Effective communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting SaaS, subscription, or high-growth sales organizations is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, ERP systems(NetSuite or similar applications), or BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.) is preferred.

Attributes

  • Process-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills.

  • Ability tomaintainconfidentiality and handle sensitive compensation data.

  • Eagerness to learn and grow within Sales Compensation and Revenue Operations.

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

  • Data accuracy obsession: you check your own work, document yourmethodology, flag data limitations proactively, and never let a bad number reach a stakeholder withouta caveat.

  • Clear written communicator: able to annotate analysis with plain-English insights,writeconcise report commentary, and explain what a metric means -not just what it is.

  • Highly organized and reliable: you manage a recurring reporting calendar, meet deadlines consistently, and proactively communicate when something is delayed or uncertain.

  • Curious and self-directed: you ask why numbers look the way they do, follow threads that seem off, and bring findings to the Director of Revenue Operations without waiting to be asked.

Company Mission

Our mission in the market we serve is clear. To power every auto-related decision through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and seamless workflows that connect insight to action.

Our Values

We POWER Our Customer's Success

We are Innovative, Collaborative and Grounded in Data

We Make Things Easy

We Get It Done

We Start with Trust & Prove it Everyday
