raw.excerpt: SummaryYelp connects people with great local businesses.
raw.description:
Summary

Yelp connects people with great local businesses. Our platform is powered by a vibrant community contributing reviews and engaging with local businesses daily. We monetize primarily through advertising, helping millions of businesses connect with high-intent consumers. The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity.

The Ads Marketplace team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering.

As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements. This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact. You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress.

This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular area in Canada. We welcome applicants from throughout Canada. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What you'll do:

  • Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation.
  • Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact.
  • Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests.
  • Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions.
  • Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace.

What it takes to succeed:

  • Experience: 8+ years of technical product management experience, preferably focused on auctions, bidding systems, search ranking, or monetization platforms within the online advertising (AdTech) industry.
  • Auction & Optimization Expertise: Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with auction theory (e.g., VCG, GSP), optimization algorithms, statistical modeling, and machine learning concepts relevant to ad targeting and ranking.
  • Advanced Analytical & Data Skills: Proven ability to independently query, manipulate, and analyze large, complex datasets. Proficiency with SQL and data analysis tools/languages (e.g., Python, R) is required.
  • Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of applied statistics, experimental design (A/B testing), causal inference, and methods for measuring statistical significance and inferring long-term impact.
  • Educational Background: Strong quantitative background; Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on technical details of algorithms, system design, and data infrastructure.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across various functions.
  • Problem Solving: Strong structured thinking and problem-solving abilities, capable of breaking down complex problems into actionable components.

What you'll get:

  • The top end of the compensation range for this role exceeds $200,000 annually. There are a variety of factors that go into determining a compensation range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data and years of experience. The actual compensation offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience and skill set. You may also be offered restricted stock units and benefits.
  • This opportunity has the option to be fully remote in all locations across Canada.
  • This role is posted to fill an existing position.
  • You can find more information about Yelp's five star benefits here!

Closing

At Yelp, we believe that diversity is an expression of all the unique characteristics that make us human: race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, and education — and those are just a few. We recognize that diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our teams and our product. The foundation of our diversity efforts are closely tied to our core values, which include “Playing Well With Others” and “Authenticity.”

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, disability, or any other protected status.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at or 1-415-969-8488.

Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

deine position

Als Category Manager B- und C-Teile verantwortest du die strategische und operative Steuerung von Warengruppen, die das Rückgrat unserer Installationskapazitäten bilden: Unterkonstruktionen sowie B- und C-Teile für PV-Anlagen, Batteriespeicher und Wärmepumpen. Du verstehst, dass diese Teile trotz ihres scheinbar geringen Einzelwerts in der Summe erheblichen Einfluss auf Kosten, Qualität und Installationsgeschwindigkeit haben. Du denkst proaktiv in Cost-Down-Potenzialen, erkennst Einsparhebel eigenständig und treibst entsprechende Initiativen – in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Standorten – strukturiert voran. Dein Ziel ist es, durch eine klare Warengruppenstrategie und strukturierte Lieferantenentwicklung nachhaltigen Mehrwert für 1KOMMA5° zu schaffen – in einem Umfeld, das schnell wächst und klare Entscheidungen braucht.


Strategischer Einkauf & Category Ownership

  • End-to-End Verantwortung für die Warengruppen Unterkonstruktionen (Montagesysteme, Schienen, Befestigungsmaterial) sowie B- und C-Teile für die Installation von PV-Anlagen, Batteriespeichern und Wärmepumpen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer klaren Warengruppenstrategie mit dem Ziel, Kosten, Qualität und Verfügbarkeit nachhaltig zu optimieren

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines resilienten, wettbewerbsfähigen Lieferantennetzwerks

  • Durchführung von Ausschreibungen (RFQ/RFP) sowie Preisverhandlungen und eigenständige Identifikation und Umsetzung von Cost-Down-Initiativen in Abstimmung mit den Standorten

Operativer Einkauf & Lieferantenmanagement

  • Steuerung und Entwicklung bestehender Lieferantenbeziehungen inkl. Performance-Monitoring

  • Sicherstellung von Lieferfähigkeit und Qualität in einem stark wachsenden Installationsumfeld

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SCM, Montage-Ops und den regionalen Standorten zur Bedarfsplanung und Priorisierung

Prozess- und Projektmanagement

  • Durchführung von Potenzialanalysen zur Identifikation von Kostenreduktionshebeln in den verantworteten Warengruppen

  • Aufbau skalierbarer Einkaufsprozesse für ein wachsendes Umfeld

  • Steuerung der Warengruppen über KPIs und zahlengetriebene Reportings

  • Standardisierung von Workflows in ERP- und Procurement-Systemen

  • Aktiver Wissenstransfer und Förderung von Best Practices im Team

dein profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain Management oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf oder Category Management

  • Technisches Verständnis für Produkte, Fertigungsverfahren und Kostenstrukturen im Bereich Installationsmaterial oder vergleichbarer Warengruppen

  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Ausschreibungen (RFQ/RFP) sowie in der Führung komplexer Preisverhandlungen

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge in der Identifikation und Umsetzung von Cost-Down-Initiativen

  • Stark datengetriebene und analytische Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Verständnis für Kostenstrukturen und Marktmechanismen

  • Strukturiertes, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Umfeld

  • Kommunikationsstark und durchsetzungsfähig im Umgang mit internen und externen Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen und modernen Procurement-Tools

benefits

  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzial, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur

Reporting to the VP of Product Management, the Product Manager is responsible for leading product execution across TraceGains platform products and capabilities, with an emphasis on driving adoption, innovation, AI-enabled productivity, and measurable business impact. This role will be located remotely in the U.S.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

Job Details:

Job Description:

Intel's Partner Marketing team is expanding. We are looking for a strategic, high-energy Partner Marketing Strategist to lead co-marketing initiatives with our world-class Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) and Independent Software Vendors (ISVs).

In this role, you won't just be managing traditional marketing campaigns. You will champion a solution-selling approach, bridging the gap between Intel's cutting-edge technologies (including AI, next-gen data centers, and client solutions) and our partners' cloud platforms. Your mission will be to translate raw hardware capabilities into high-value, workload-optimized business solutions that solve real-world customer challenges.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Co-Marketing Leadership:

  • Set the Vision: Develop and execute comprehensive, full-year co-marketing strategies that align Intel's top priorities with our partners' business goals across global, regional, and country levels.

  • Drive the Narrative: Position Intel as the preferred engine behind cloud innovation through joint value propositions.

High-Impact Partner Engagement:

  • Build Strong Alliances: Cultivate and manage deep relationships with CSP marketing organizations, engaging confidently with stakeholders from mid-level managers to senior leadership.

  • Bridge the Gap: Act as the primary liaison between partner teams and Intel's regional partner marketing managers to ensure flawless global alignment.

End-to-End Campaign Mastery:

  • Execute with Excellence: Lead the end-to-end project management of co-marketing campaigns-from creative concept and media planning to final execution.

  • Measure What Matters: Own the budget, track KPIs, and deliver rigorous ROI analyses to prove the business impact of every campaign.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Orchestrate Internal Teams: Partner closely with Global Field Sales, Business Group Marketing, and country-level teams to ensure joint campaigns are integrated and amplified across all channels.

  • Program Governance and Enablement:

  • Manage the Plan of Record (POR): Maintain and update the account's POR, managing co-marketing approvals with precision.

  • Enable Partners: Educate and train partners on program enhancements, guidelines, and toolsets to maximize program participation and compliance.

  • Brand Integrity: Evaluate partner executions to ensure seamless Intel branding integration and adherence to program guidelines.

Executive Communication:

  • Tell the Story: Translate complex campaign data into compelling narratives. Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive-level briefings.

Thrive in Ambiguity:

  • A strategic thinker with a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguous environments, drive clarity, and deliver highly measurable marketing results.

Qualifications:

This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

  • Cloud Marketing Expertise: 6+ years of dedicated cloud marketing, partner marketing, or alliance marketing experience (ideally working directly with or within Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) or SaaS/Enterprise Software partners).

  • Customer-Facing Experience: 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role within a Global Sales or Global Marketing organization, with a proven track record of managing high-value relationships.

  • Project and Vendor Management: Proven experience managing multiple complex workstreams across diverse internal teams and external partners, including marketing agencies, retailers, and media vendors.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Intel and AI Ecosystem Knowledge: A strong understanding of Intel's AI solutions, product portfolios, data center technologies, and broader B2B tech landscape.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional cross-functional leadership and influencing skills, with a genuine passion for collaborating across a highly matrixed global organization.

  • Polished Communication: Elite customer engagement, relationship management, and presentation skills-comfortable speaking the language of both tech engineers and senior executives.

  • Solution Selling Mindset: Experience applying solution selling methodologies to B2B marketing. Proven ability to translate complex technical specifications (like CPU/GPU performance) into customer-centric business value propositions and joint solution architectures.

  • Vertical Industry Marketing: Experience designing and executing marketing campaigns tailored to specific industry verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, or Public Sector) to show how joint cloud solutions solve unique sector-specific challenges.

Why Join Intel?

At Intel, we are game-changers, boundary-pushers, and innovators. In this role, you will have a front-row seat to the future of cloud computing and the autonomy to build marketing campaigns that reach millions of businesses worldwide. We offer a competitive benefits package, a collaborative hybrid work environment, and massive opportunities for career growth.

Experienced Hire

raw.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Product Manager, joining our Product team in the Fintech vertical. As a Billing Platform Product Manager, you will be a key member of our triad of product managers in the billing team, each leading their independent teams yet working within an interconnected scope.

As a Product Manager at Remote, you'll be developing and guiding our strategy for a key product area in Finance. You'll advance this vision by working with a cross-functional engineering and design group to find our most important problems and shape iterative solutions towards them.

What you bring

  • Prior experience as product manager in billing / invoicing or similar, ideally at a high-growth company
  • Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code or similar tool. You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional prototypes or small code changes with the help of AI tooling, not just write specs.
  • Great judgment making both strategic (what to prioritize) and tactical (feature scope) decisions
  • Demonstrable, self-driven results that have moved a product in the right direction
  • A passion for creating seamless and effective products, even when the challenges they address are complex and intricate.
  • Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, including across different departments (e.g. business operations, sales, etc.) to ensure that we’re satisfying critical business requirements
  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken.
  • Bonus: Experience working in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build solutions together with the rest of the team that solve for finance, billing and other financial services at Remote
    • Own not just software implementation, but the end-to-end experience: Remote delivers value through services powered by both humans and software
    • Lead on complex solutions without requiring support or involvement from senior members of the product team
    • Effectively manage internal expectations for complex projects, products, and features while navigating challenging prioritization decisions
  • Drive Remote in the right direction by building an effective roadmap and strategy for your area of the product in Finance
    • Break down strategic plans into near and mid-term goals that's easy for others to understand
    • Align your product roadmap with higher level department and company problems we’re working to solve
    • Be the subject matter expert for your product area
    • Contribute to scaling and growth plans for your product area
  • Ship improvements quickly and iteratively, challenging yourself and counterparts to find minimal solutions to problems
    • Support and leads a product team delivering high throughput and high return on investment
    • Understand key business KPIs and align your team's work and metrics to directly improve to these
    • Work together with engineers, designers and stakeholders to build solutions to important complex problems
  • Communicate and collaborate internally and externally
    • Contribute to the Product org by sharing your techniques, processes, and learnings
    • Communicate and promote the work of your team and why it matters to customers and internal teams
    • Work asynchronously and transparently
    • Lead on solutions with minimal support or involvement from senior members of the product team. You should be able to work autonomously on simple features and iterations, only needing support to solve complex problems
    • Contribute to tactical and strategic decision-making for your business area
    • Develop into a subject matter expert for understanding, articulating, and solving complex business problems related to our mobile experiences

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Group Product Manager
  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. AI Interview
  2. Interview with recruiter
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Live brainstorming session
  5. Interview with team members
  6. Bar Raiser Interview
  7. Interview with CTO
  8. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$62,400—$140,400 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Software Product Management Lead to drive product vision, roadmap development, user story definition, and stakeholder engagement for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role leads the end-to-end product lifecycle, aligning user needs, mission objectives, and technical capabilities into a cohesive and actionable product strategy.

The Software Product Management Lead partners with engineering teams, UX specialists, PMO leadership, and mission stakeholders to prioritize features, refine requirements, manage backlogs, and ensure product releases deliver measurable value.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Software Product Management Lead will:

  • Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with mission and user needs.
  • Lead backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and user story refinement.
  • Develop clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature descriptions.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirement-gathering sessions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between engineering, UX, QA, security, and operations teams.
  • Manage product lifecycles from concept through delivery and iterative improvement.
  • Analyze user feedback, operational metrics, and mission needs to adjust product priorities.
  • Ensure product decisions are data-driven and aligned with enterprise objectives.
  • Support release planning, roadmap presentations, and executive-level product briefings.
  • Maintain product documentation, decision logs, and feature tracking artifacts.
  • Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement across product teams.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in product management, software development leadership, or Agile delivery roles.
  • Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, and user-focused features.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Experience collaborating with technical teams to translate user needs into actionable stories.
  • Experience supporting product management in federal or enterprise environments preferred.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of Agile product delivery, backlog management, and sprint planning.
  • Knowledge of software development processes, technical requirements, and system dependencies.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices and their alignment with product operations.
  • Understanding of user experience considerations and mission-driven feature prioritization.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with data-driven decision-making frameworks for product prioritization.

Certifications

Required:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation
  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)

Preferred:

  • PMP or Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)
  • Additional product management or Agile leadership certifications

Skills

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent analytical and prioritization abilities.
  • Ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to lead product direction in a fast-paced mission environment.

raw.title: Platform and Automation Engineer - Remote
raw.excerpt: About UsAt Zyte, we eat data for breakfast, and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte.
raw.description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast, and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

The Role

Zyte is seeking a Senior IT Systems Engineer with strong Business Systems and Automation experience to architect and operate the internal technology ecosystem that powers our global company.

This role goes beyond endpoint management and traditional IT support — it treats internal IT as an engineering discipline, with code-first automation as the default approach. You will design and operate the backbone of Zyte's internal SaaS platform, integrating systems like Salesforce, HubSpot, finance systems, HR platforms, engineering tools, and collaboration software into a coherent, automated architecture. You'll also play a key role in introducing AI-assisted and AI-driven workflows across the company.

Requirements

Business Systems Engineering

  • Administer and integrate business-critical SaaS systems, such as:
    • Salesforce or HubSpot
    • Customer support platforms (Zendesk, Intercom, etc.)
    • Billing or subscription systems (Stripe, Chargebee, etc.)
    • Collaboration and engineering tools (Atlassian, GitHub, Notion)
  • Design reliable workflows and data synchronization across multiple SaaS platforms
  • Engineer Internal Automation Systems: You will spend a significant portion of your time writing code and building automation tooling, not just configuring SaaS products.
    Using modern development environments (IDEs, CLIs, SDKs), you will build scripts, services, and integrations that automate Zyte’s internal operations. Typical work includes:
    • writing automation scripts in Python, Go, or similar languages
    • building internal CLI tools for common IT and business workflows
    • developing small internal services that integrate the SaaS platform
    • building event-driven automation pipelines using APIs and webhooks
    • developing internal bots and ChatOps integrations.
  • Build and Maintain SaaS Integrations: Design and implement reliable, API-driven integrations between business systems, including:
    • CRM automation across Salesforce / HubSpot
    • Syncing customer, billing, and product usage data
      Automating entitlement provisioning across internal systems
      Connecting support, product, and CRM workflows..
  • Develop Internal Tools: Build internal tools that improve operational efficiency across teams, like:
    • Internal CLI tools for IT and operations.
    • Automation services for onboarding and access management.
    • Data synchronization services between internal systems.
    • Dashboards and automation services for business operations.
    • ChatOps tools for Slack or internal collaboration platforms.
  • Introduce AI into Internal Workflows: Identify opportunities to use modern AI technologies to automate or augment internal operations, examples include:
    • AI-powered internal support assistants
    • LLM-driven knowledge retrieval across internal documentation
    • Automated ticket triage and resolution
    • AI copilots for internal SaaS workflows
    • Automated analysis of operational data
  • Design the Internal "IT Golden Path": Create automated and developer-friendly workflows for employees and teams, building, for example:
    • Automated onboarding and offboarding pipelines.
    • Identity and access provisioning automation.
    • Self-service automation for common IT tasks.
    • Internal developer-friendly APIs for business systems.
  • IT Service Management & Operations: Serve as the ultimate level of IT Support for end-users, delivering superior IT assistance to a global, remote workforce. Emphasize comprehensive root-cause analysis and a 'person-first' philosophy in service delivery.
  • Security & Compliance Engineering: Ensure continuous operational adherence to established ISO frameworks. Implement and administer comprehensive endpoint security measures, including Mobile Device Management (JumpCloud), enterprise-grade password management solutions, and conduct routine access audits to rigorously enforce Zero Trust architecture principles.

Requirements

    • 8+ years in IT Engineering, Systems Engineering, Business Systems Engineering, or Platform Engineering, including 3+ years in a senior role owning internal business systems and automation at a SaaS/tech company
    • Scripting Mastery: Strong scripting and programming ability in Python, Go, , Bash,.
    • Cloud Infrastructure: Solid experience operating GCP & AWS environments (VPCs, IAM roles, EC2/S3).
    • API & Integration Engineering: Strong experience working with external APIs, including:
      • REST and GraphQL APIs
      • OAuth authentication flows
      • Webhook-based event systems
      • SaaS SDKs and integration frameworks.
    • Operating Systems: Deep working knowledge of macOS and Linux environments.
    • Identity & Security: experience implementing and managing:
      • SSO / SAML / SCIM provisioning
      • Identity lifecycle automation
      • Zero Trust access models
    • Compliance & Governance: Experience supporting or passing security and compliance audits, such as:
      • ISO 27001 | SOC2 | GDPR
    • Experience working in remote-first or globally distributed environments is strongly preferred

Preferred Skills

  • AI-Assisted Automation: Experience experimenting with or implementing AI-driven automation, such as:
    • LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
    • AI copilots for operational workflows
    • Semantic search or knowledge retrieval systems
    • Automated support or ticket triage using AI
  • Containerization: Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes for running internal IT microservices
  • SRE Mindset: Experience applying SLIs/SLOs to internal IT services to measure "uptime" of the employee experience.

Who You Are

  • Autonomous: You don’t need a manual. You prioritize complex backlogs independently and lead from the front.
  • People-Centric: You have great interpersonal skills and clear communication. You solve for the person, not just the machine.
  • AI-Driven: You are enthusiastic about leveraging AI tools to automate, enhance, and continuously improve internal IT business processes.
  • Security Minded: You understand the "why" behind security frameworks and MDM, balancing safety with organizational speed.
  • Growth-Oriented: You are proactive. When you see a gap in a process, you own the solution.

Benefits

  • Total Flexibility: We are 100% remote. Work from where you are most productive.
  • Innovation Culture: We encourage "hacking" internal processes. If a task is manual, we want you to automate it.
  • Cutting Edge: Work with a tech stack that mirrors our production environment—modern, fast, and open-source-centric.

The company's mission is to help industry professionals unlock their potential and achieve their most important goals, all united by the belief that its clients’ success is not just a milestone, but a shared mission.

As a team, we’re on a mission to reshape an age-old industry, and we’re looking for people who thrive on challenging and meaningful work. Our environment is highly collaborative, innovative, and supportive, with a shared commitment to having fun while making an impact. We live by our core values: We Before Me, Bias to Act, The Extra 1%, Accountable to Outcomes, Unconditional Transparency, and Forgiveness. If this resonates with you, we’d love to meet you and explore how you can help us build the future of the green industry!

Our culture and growth has been recognized with multiple awards, it’s a great time to join!

  • Comparably 2024 #23/100 Best (small/ medium sized companies) Leadership Teams
  • Comparably 2024 #63/75 (small/ medium sized companies) Happiest Employees

About the Role:

Our existing clients have already bet on Granum, and this role exists to make sure they're getting everything they came for. As an Expansion & Pay SDR, you'll be calling into our current customer base to uncover untapped value: connecting clients to products they're not yet using, driving adoption of our invoicing and payments solution, and generating expansion revenue by deepening the relationship.

This isn't cold calling into a cold market. You're reaching people who already know us, which means conversations start with trust and move faster when you bring the right energy and the right story. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Onboarding, and the payments team to identify the right moments to engage and make sure clients land on the full platform.

You're a natural relationship-builder who gets energized by helping people see what's possible. You ask good questions, listen closely, and know how to connect a client's current frustrations to a solution that's already inside their account.

What You'll Do:

  • Call into our existing customer base to identify and qualify expansion opportunities, with a focus on upsell and cross-sell of the invoicing and payments product
  • Drive adoption conversations with clients who haven't yet activated key Granum features
  • Qualify and book expansion meetings for the Customer Success team, building pipeline from within the existing book of business
  • Run high-volume outreach, phone-first with email and sequences as support, staying organized and consistent in your activity
  • Partner with the Payment team and Customer Success to identify expansion signals and coordinate warm handoffs
  • Track activity, pipeline, and outcomes in Salesforce with accuracy and discipline
  • Stay sharp on the invoicing and payments product so you can speak to it confidently and handle common objections in the moment
  • Share what messaging is landing, what objections you're hearing, and what's moving clients to act

Does This Sound Like You?

  • Previous experience in sales, customer success, or account management is a plus, especially if you've had upsell or expansion conversations
  • You're personable, energetic, and genuinely enjoy talking to people
  • You're a natural conversationalist who can move from small talk to a real business conversation without it feeling forced
  • You're goals-oriented and motivated by hitting numbers
  • You're organized and disciplined, because high-volume outreach requires a system
  • You work well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and take feedback well
  • You can pick up a product quickly and speak to it with confidence
  • You're looking to build a career in sales and see this as a launchpad

Compensation:

  • Canada-based candidates: Base $65-70,000 CAD + $20,000 CAD on target commission
  • US-based candidates: Base $55-60,000 USD + $30,000 USD on target commission

Reasons why you would love it here!

  • Join a team culture that’s all about collaboration, support, and having fun while making a real impact every day.
  • In the U.S., we offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options, plus additional add ons like HSA/FSA accounts, disability and life insurance, and more.
  • In Canada, we provide an employer-funded HSA-based benefits plan with drug, dental, and mental health coverage - giving you a flexible way to manage your healthcare needs.
  • We're committed to your financial future, with 401(k) matching for U.S. employees and RRSP matching for those in Canada.
  • We invest in your growth through tailored career development conversations and support for tools, courses, and resources to help you thrive.
  • And when it comes to work-life balance? We offer unlimited Paid Time Off, paid company holidays, and a company-wide winter break from December 24 to January 1 - so you can truly recharge.

Granum does not sponsor work authorization needs; candidates must have proper work authorization to work for any employer in Canada or the U.S, without sponsorship from the company.

Project – the aim you’ll have

We are seeking an experienced SharePoint Administrator to support SharePoint Online within a Microsoft 365 environment. The role covers SharePoint admin centre activity, site administration, permissions, end-user technical support, troubleshooting, standard change delivery, documentation and user guidance.
The role sits in a financial services / investment management context, with a focus on operational control, auditability, least-privilege access and reliable service delivery.

Position – how you’ll contribute

Platform administration and service management

  • Administer SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, pages and related Microsoft 365 collaboration services.
  • Manage permissions, SharePoint groups, Microsoft 365 Groups, sharing and guest access, including investigation and resolution of access issues.
  • Provide technical support to end users, troubleshooting incidents and directing service requests through agreed service management processes.
  • Escalate and liaise with Senior SharePoint Administrators where issues require deeper technical input, approval or exception handling.
  • Perform routine monitoring, housekeeping and recovery support for SharePoint Online services using various admin tools; such as SharePoint Admin Center, Sharegate, PnP PowerShell and DeliverPoint.
  • Implement documented production changes in line with governance controls.
  • Governance, security and information management
  • Apply governance and security standards across permissions, sharing and ownership.
  • Review permission inheritance, oversharing, external sharing and site ownership issues, escalating exceptions where required.
  • Assist in planning and executing support and recovery operations.
  • Support metadata, taxonomy, retention, sensitivity, search and content lifecycle controls.
  • Work with technology, security and compliance teams to support organisational and regulatory requirements.
  • Project support, user enablement and collaboration
  • Support site builds, migrations, restructures, hub or site association changes and handover to BAU.
  • Translate agreed requirements into practical SharePoint configuration using standard features.
  • Provide SharePoint training and guidance to users and site owners on permissions, sharing, content management and agreed standards.
  • Maintain FAQs, procedure notes and knowledge articles.
  • Support trainee administrator(s) through coaching and knowledge sharing.
  • Communicate clearly with technology, security, compliance, project and business teams.

Expectations – the experience you need

  • 3–5+ years’ relevant experience in a SharePoint Administrator, Microsoft 365 Administrator, Collaboration Platform Analyst or similar role.
  • Strong SharePoint Online administration skills across sites, libraries, lists, pages, metadata, permissions, sharing and ownership.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Groups, Teams, OneDrive and Outlook, and how they interact with SharePoint Online.
  • Experience with ShareGate migrations, restructures, hub sites and communication sites.
  • Basic PowerShell capability for SharePoint Online administration, including PnP PowerShell or SharePoint Online Management Shell.
  • Comfortable with end-user technical support and troubleshooting SharePoint incidents, requests and access issues through structured processes.
  • Awareness of lifecycle, sensitivity classification, metadata and external sharing controls.
  • Strong documentation, communication and end-user training skills.

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Experience working in financial services, investment management or another regulated environment.
  • Broader experience with DeliverPoint, ShareGate, PnP PowerShell or SharePoint Online Management Shell.
  • Support-level understanding of Power Platform integration points with SharePoint, including Power Automate and Power Apps.
  • Experience assessing Message Centre, Service Health or roadmap updates.

Our offer – professional development, personal growth

  • International projects with leading global clients

  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Language classes

  • Private healthcare and insurance

About the role

Provides technical leadership and operational support to Video Template Review teams. Owns tooling, AI-assisted workflows, technical standards, and review processes that ensure high-quality, scalable, and efficient review of motion graphics, video templates, and related creative assets.

What you'll be doing

  • Review and analysis of video templates, motion graphics, After Effects projects, Premiere Pro templates, DaVinci Resolve templates, and related assets.
  • Lead technical upskilling and tooling adoption for Video Template Reviewers.
  • Test, deploy, and optimize AI-assisted review workflows for template content.
  • Establish and maintain technical review standards across supported software platforms.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to improve template review systems and workflows.
  • Monitor quality trends, compatibility issues, and operational risks.
  • Support escalations involving template functionality, licensing, copyright, AI-generated content, and technical performance.
  • Drive automation and innovation initiatives within Video Template Review operations.
  • Ensure ethical and responsible use of AI in template review workflows.

About you

  • Strong knowledge of motion graphics, video production, and template-based creative workflows.
  • Experience with Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar tools.
  • Understanding of template structure, expressions, plugins, rendering workflows, and asset dependencies.
  • Experience reviewing creative assets for functionality, usability, and commercial quality.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted content creation tools and workflows.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements into reviewer guidance and documentation.
  • Strong collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Content Operations teams.

Life at Envato

• Flexible Working: remote-first with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need.
• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.
• Conoce Mexico: a unique travel benefit for you to explore and visit new places across Mexico.
• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.
• Learning Budget - Study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.
• Home Office Allowance: contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.
• Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health.
• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.
• Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave.
• Christmas Bonus, Paid Holidays and Holiday Bonus: we offer 30 days paid in December, you will have 12 days vacation in the first year, and you will earn 100% of holiday bonus.
• Grocery tickets: we offer you a monthly amount of 5% (subject to the legal cap) in food vouchers, which can be used in markets, pharmacies and more.
• 5% Saving Funds (fondo de ahorro).
• Private Health Insurance (SGMM).
• Unlimited Ebooks.
By submitting your application you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy. If you would like to understand how we handle personal information before submitting your application, please read through our Privacy Policy.
Research shows candidates from neurodiverse and underrepresented backgrounds often only apply for roles if they meet all the criteria. We like to make our hiring decisions based on lived experience, so if you’re keen to apply and need reasonable adjustments please let us know.
We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

As a Team Lead within SIDE's Global Player Support organisation, you will lead a team of Player Support Specialists through onboarding, operational readiness, and live service delivery.

You will be responsible for creating an environment where people can succeed through structured coaching, performance management, operational guidance, and continuous development.

Working closely with Quality, Training, Operations, and Workforce Management, you will help ensure the team delivers a consistent player experience while meeting operational expectations.

Requirements

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead a team of Player Support Specialists through onboarding, training, and operational readiness.
  • Create a positive, supportive, and accountable team culture.
  • Deliver regular one-to-one meetings, coaching sessions, and performance reviews.
  • Monitor operational performance against agreed service, quality, productivity, and compliance expectations.
  • Support onboarding, nesting, and role readiness activities for new starters.
  • Work closely with Quality, Training, and Operations to identify coaching opportunities and improve performance.
  • Escalate operational risks, staffing concerns, and player-impacting issues when required.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the team.
  • Support operational readiness activities before launch and stabilization following go live.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience leading Player Support, Customer Support, Trust and Safety, or Customer Experience teams.
  • Strong coaching and people leadership skills.
  • Experience managing operational performance through quality, productivity, and service metrics.
  • Ability to balance operational priorities while supporting individual development.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Confidence working in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Passion for developing people and creating high-performing teams.

Keys For Success

  • Build confident, capable teams through coaching and structured development.
  • Create a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver operational consistency while supporting player experience.
  • Support readiness through onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.
  • Help teams transition confidently into live operations.

raw.title: Senior Engineer - Protection & Control
raw.excerpt: Position OverviewPower Your Future with Qualus in our Transmission & Distribution Canada business.
raw.description:
Position Overview

Power Your Future with Qualus in our Transmission & Distribution Canada business. We are seeking a Protection & Controls Engineer to join our growing team of engineers and designers.

This role offers long-term workload stability, exposure to a diverse portfolio of utility projects, and the opportunity to lead technical delivery across all stages of substation project execution.

You will lead the design and delivery of protection, control, and metering systems for substations ranging from 12 kV to 500 kV, supporting projects from early concept through construction and commissioning. This position is ideal for an experienced engineer who is ready to take ownership of design packages, lead project coordination, and serve as a technical interface with clients in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate the design of protection, control, and metering systems for electrical substations (12 kV to 500 kV)
  • Take ownership of project-level deliverables, ensuring quality, completeness, and alignment with client and project requirements
  • Serve as Project Lead on assigned projects, including:
    • Developing and reviewing one-line diagrams, protection schematics, and wiring diagrams
    • Leading the preparation of panel layouts and interconnection drawings
    • Preparing and reviewing engineering documents, specifications, and construction packages
    • Supporting development of outage staging, inspection, and testing plans
  • Provide technical oversight and perform design reviews of work completed by EITs and designers
  • Support construction and commissioning activities, including troubleshooting and resolving technical issues in the field
  • Participate in and lead factory acceptance testing (FAT) and inspections
  • Act as a technical point of contact for clients, supporting design reviews, constructability discussions, and project coordination
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (civil/structural, physical, telecom, etc.) to ensure integrated and coordinated designs
  • Support project delivery by managing scope, schedule, and budget for assigned work packages
  • Contribute to continuous improvement, quality assurance, and development of internal standards and best practices
  • Mentor and support the development of junior engineers and designers

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university
  • Registered as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Canada, or eligible for registration
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in utility protection, control, and metering design, preferably within transmission and distribution projects
  • Demonstrated experience leading design efforts and coordinating technical deliverables on projects
  • Experience working with BC Hydro or similar utilities is considered a strong asset
  • Familiarity with substation protection and control systems, including relaying schemes, AC/DC schematics, and station design practices
  • Exposure to SCADA and automation systems design and implementation is considered an asset
  • Understanding of utility maintenance and operational practices is an asset
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to develop practical, technically sound solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams
  • Proven ability to lead work, manage priorities, and deliver results in a deadline-driven environment
  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD; familiarity with protection and controls tools or relay software is an asset

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus benefits offered include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays, for those who qualify.

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The salary range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

EEO

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.
